name: Mahokoi ~Ecchi na Mahou de Koi x Koi Shichau~
original_name: まほこい～エッチな魔法で恋×濃しちゃう～
source:
Seiji is back to his hometown and Aoi, his old friend, Akane, his classmate, and Hinano, his younger sister help him move to his new house. All of a sudden, a girl falls down his room. Her name is Chocolat and she is a magical girl, according to her. She casts magic to repair the roof of his house, but it fails and all of them become able to use magic instead.... Also, Seiji's body changes and he can't stop chasing girls. To get back to normal, he needs a full-fledged magical girl, but there is none. Seiji finally makes up his mind to train one of them to become a full-fledged magical girl....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081103100820/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011119]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
诚司回到了家乡，老朋友葵、同学茜和妹妹日野帮助他搬进了新家。突然，一个女孩从他的房间里掉下来。她的名字叫巧克力，据她说，她是一个魔法少女。她施展魔法修复了他家的屋顶，但失败了，所有人都可以使用魔法了……而且，Seiji的身体发生了变化，他无法停止追逐女孩。为了恢复正常，他需要一个成熟的魔法少女，但没有。诚司终于下定决心，要培养她们中的一位，让她们成为一名真正的魔法少女……
